claim_text: DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET
summary: DoorDash's status page listed a Drive endpoints incident at 11:30 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21 ('an increase in errors on drive endpoints') and said at 11:50 AM ET: 'We are seeing recovery. Team will continue to monitor.'
detail: We read DoorDash's official status page feed directly on Nov 21 at 2:54 PM ET (s009). Its entries match the times relayed earlier by IsDown and Men's Journal: 'investigating' at 11:30 AM ET and 'monitoring' at 11:50 AM ET. The incident covers the Drive API component, which DoorDash moved from partial outage back to operational at 11:50 AM ET. Drive is DoorDash's white-label delivery service for businesses, per Men's Journal.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DoorDash's own status page gives the entries and times; two outlets relayed the same entries.
notes: u003: official status page read directly at www.doordashstatus.com (s009); status.doordash.com still not readable by our fetch.

claim_text: DoorDash opened a second status-page incident, titled 'DoorDash Health Degredation', at about 11:33 AM ET, saying 'We are currently investigating this issue'
summary: Three minutes after the Drive entry, DoorDash opened a second status-page incident titled 'DoorDash Health Degredation' (its spelling): 'We are currently investigating this issue.' DoorDash later marked it resolved.
detail: DoorDash's status page lists the incident's impact as none and ties it to one component, Merchant - Marketplace Orders, which stayed operational throughout. Men's Journal describes it as being about degraded service. We read the status page feed directly on Nov 21 at 2:54 PM ET.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DoorDash's own status page (Tier 1, read directly) gives the title, time, text and component.
notes: u003: Reported to Confirmed. The Editor-in-Chief's u002 condition was a direct read of the official status page; s009 is that read (www.doordashstatus.com, the page the status monitors cite).

claim_text: More than 12,700 outage reports were filed on Downdetector on Nov 21
summary: Hindustan Times says Downdetector had logged 12,742 reports by the time of writing; Men's Journal says Downdetector showed thousands of reports. A third site (Sportskeeda) says more than 14,000 but says it could not verify the count.
detail: Downdetector counts reports that users submit, not the number of customers affected. Men's Journal gives the mix as 79% app problems, 11% login and 6% checkout at about noon ET. The numbers differ between outlets and we did not read Downdetector.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Hindustan Times gives the 12,742 figure and Men's Journal confirms thousands of reports; both cite Downdetector.

claim_text: Customers saw an error message in the DoorDash app and website: 'Whoops. We experienced an error while executing your request.'
summary: Hindustan Times and Times Now report users across the US seeing 'Whoops. We experienced an error while executing your request. Please try again.' with Retry and Log Out options, and say the app and website were not working.
detail: The accounts come from user posts quoted by the outlets. Some users also reported they could not change a delivery address or log in.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Two outlets describe the same error screen from users' reports.

claim_text: Downdetector user reports began at about 11:02 AM ET
summary: Men's Journal says user reports of DoorDash problems began at 11:02 AM ET, citing Downdetector's own post. Sportskeeda puts the start of the rise at about 11:20 AM.
detail: This is when reports began, not when DoorDash's systems failed. DoorDash's own status entries start at 11:30 AM ET.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Men's Journal cites Downdetector's post for the 11:02 start; Sportskeeda gives a later time.

claim_text: The Drive endpoints incident caused the app and website failures
summary: No source links the Drive API incident on the status page to the consumer app and website errors. Drive is a separate business delivery product.
detail: DoorDash has not said how the two incidents relate. Its Nov 24 post-incident note covers only the second incident ('Health Degredation'): a database connectivity issue on an internal address service caused errors across DoorDash services from about 10:55 to 11:45 AM ET. That note speaks of partners and does not name the app or website, and the Drive incident's own post mortem has not been posted.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The status entries name the Drive API and a merchant orders component, not the consumer app or website.
notes: u004: detail refreshed for the Health Degredation post-incident note; label unchanged (the note does not cover Drive).

claim_text: The outage was caused by a hack
summary: People on social media asked whether DoorDash was being hacked; Hindustan Times quotes one user asking. No source provides evidence of an attack, and DoorDash's post-incident note gives a technical cause without mentioning one.
detail: The claim rests on speculation only. No official, security researcher or outlet reports signs of an intrusion. DoorDash blames a database connectivity issue on an internal address service but has not said whether it ruled out an attack, so the claim is not Debunked.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: Hindustan Times quotes the question from social media; it offers no evidence.
notes: u004: summary and detail refreshed for DoorDash's post-incident note; label unchanged.

claim_text: DoorDash has said the outage was or was not a cyberattack
summary: We found no DoorDash statement about a cyberattack, in either direction. DoorDash's Nov 24 post-incident note gives the cause as a database connectivity issue on an internal address service and does not mention an attack.
detail: This is not a denial. A stated technical cause is not the same as DoorDash saying an attack was ruled out, and DoorDash has not done that as far as we found.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither the status entries, including the post-incident note, nor the outlets we read report a statement about an attack.
notes: u004: summary refreshed for the post-incident note; label unchanged.

claim_text: DoorDash says a database connectivity issue on an internal address service caused errors across its services on Nov 21
summary: DoorDash's post-incident note, posted Nov 24 on its status page: 'The cause was a database connectivity issue on an internal address service.' It says partners saw errors and delays across DoorDash services from about 10:55 to 11:45 AM ET.
detail: The note says the errors included order creation and confirmation and that teams restored the connectivity. It is written for DoorDash's business partners and does not name the consumer app or website, though its time window matches when customers began reporting errors (about 11:02 AM ET). It does not say what made the database connection fail, and it does not mention an attack. The separate Drive incident has no post mortem yet; its status-page component still says 'Post Mortem will be posted later.'
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DoorDash's own post-incident note on its official status page (Tier 1, read directly) states the cause.
notes: u004: Not established to Confirmed; DoorDash posted the post-incident note at 3:12 PM ET on Nov 24. Claim text narrowed to what DoorDash stated.

summary: Yes. DoorDash marked the Drive incident resolved at 1:58 PM ET ('This incident has been resolved.'). At 2:50 PM ET it marked the 'Health Degredation' incident resolved, with the note 'Incident was resolved at 8:51AM PST' (11:51 AM ET).
detail: Read directly from DoorDash's official status page feed at 2:54 PM ET; PulsAPI and FlareWarden show the same resolved entries. These resolve the status-page incidents only. DoorDash has not said when the app and website were fully back for every customer.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: DoorDash's own status page (Tier 1, read directly) shows both incidents resolved, with times.
notes: u003: Not established to Confirmed; both Resolved updates found on the official status page.

claim_text: The outage is tied to other outages this month
summary: No source we found links the DoorDash outage to other recent outages or attacks.
detail: A coincidence in timing is not a link, and DoorDash named no outside provider.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither the status entries nor the coverage mention any other company or event.
